title: The non-Buffer fallback branch (`: ''`) is the only uncovered path in the new m…
body: The non-Buffer fallback branch (`: ''`) is the only uncovered path in the new module. It is genuinely hard to trigger with stdout:'pipe'/stderr:'pipe' (it exists because Bun types SyncSubprocess stdout/stderr as Buffer | undefined), so leaving it uncovered is defensible; noting it only so the gap is a known one rather than an assumed-covered one.
